C1275.title: Fake Official Sites Target Global Luxury Brands: 5,000 Yuan Online Gucci Purchase Turns Out to Be Super-A Counterfeit
C1275.summary: In June 2009, criminals set up 'fake official websites' impersonating international brands such as Gucci and LV to sell counterfeits as genuine online. Consumer Chen Xiaoli selected a bag marked 50% off on a fake site disguised as Gucci's official website and spent 5,000 yuan, only to receive a so-called 'one-to-one' quality super-A counterfeit. The case shows how fake sites copy brand page designs and use similar domain names to defraud consumers and damage brand reputation.

references.title: High-Fidelity Counterfeits of Luxury Brand Official Websites - Sina Style (Jiefang Daily)
